title: TrailPaths
description: Allows players to leave a path behind them while walking.
body:
# TrailPaths

TrailPaths is a simple and lightweight plugin that allows players to create a "path" behind them as they walk. You can configure any block type to change into another, and even set a timer to automatically reset the path to its original state. It is a unique, immersive addition for any server.

## ⭐ Key Features
- Customizable Trails: Define exactly which block types should be replaced and what they should turn into.
- Randomized Patterns: Use percentage-based chances to vary the appearance of your paths (e.g., a mix of Dirt and Coarse Dirt).
- Automatic Reset: Optionally configure the paths to revert to their original state after a set period, keeping your world clean.
- Toggleable: Players can easily turn their personal trail on or off whenever they like.

## ✏️ Commands
**/trails help**
- Description: View the plugin commands.
- Permission: TRAILS.HELP
**/trails reload**
- Description: Reloads the configuration files.
- Permission: TRAILS.RELOAD
**/trails**
- Description: Toggle your trail path on and off.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE
**/trails on**
- Description: Toggle your trail path on.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE
**/trails off**
- Description: Toggle your trail path off.
- Permission: TRAILS.TOGGLE

## ✏️ Permissions
- TRAILS.*: Grants access to all plugin commands and features.
- TRAILS.HELP: Allows the user to use the /trails help command.
- TRAILS.RELOAD: Allows the user to reload the configuration file.
- TRAILS.TOGGLE: Allows the user to toggle trail paths on/off.
